patch_description: Split the 7 perfect matchings of K8 into three non-commuting stages separated by two mid-circuit RY+RX mixers instead of one. This creates three genuinely independent entangling layers (matchings 1-3, 4-5, 6-7) with non-commuting single-qubit rotations between them. The key insight is that consecutive CZ gates commute, so splitting them with parametrized rotations effectively increases the circuit's expressive power. This adds only 2 shared parameters per block (from 6 to 8), going from 38 to 50 total parameters, while significantly increasing the effective circuit depth and expressivity. The 3-2-2 split ensures a good balance of short-range (matchings 1-2), long-range (matching 3), cross (4-5), and diagonal (6-7) entanglement in each stage.
